partners.diseaseBName: severe combined immunodeficiency due to DNA-PKcs deficiency
partners.mechanism_chain: TREX1 (HGNC:24474) —DECREASES→ Interferon signaling pathway (GO:0034340); Interferon signaling pathway (GO:0034340) —LEADS_TO→ Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome 1 (MONDO:0009165); PRKDC (HGNC:9413) —DISRUPTS→ Non-Homologous End Joining (NHEJ) DNA repair (REACT:R-HSA-1240251); Non-Homologous End Joining (NHEJ) DNA repair (REACT:R-HSA-1240251) —LEADS_TO→ Impaired lymphocyte development (HP:0002714); Impaired lymphocyte development (HP:0002714) —LEADS_TO→ Severe combined immunodeficiency due to DNA-PKcs deficiency (MONDO:0014423). Loss-of-function mutations in TREX1 impair DNA degradation, leading to aberrant activation of the interferon signaling pathway and Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome 1. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in PRKDC disrupt the crucial NHEJ DNA repair pathway, resulting in impaired lymphocyte development and severe combined immunodeficiency. The convergence lies in the shared impact on DNA integrity and repair, albeit through distinct initial mechanisms, both contributing to severe clinical phenotypes.

falsification.text: If genetic analysis reveals that mutations in TREX1 do not lead to increased interferon signaling or that PRKDC mutations do not impair NHEJ and lymphocyte development, this hypothesis would be falsified. falsification.gnomad_variant: Any common pathogenic variant (AF > 0.01) in PRKDC associated with Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome 1.
